name: Ray of Bedevilment, Greater
body:
School enchantment [mind-affecting]; Level bard 5, mesmerist 5
Effect multiple rays of chaotic light
Duration 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as ray of bedevilment except it allows you to shoot one ray per round. The dazed duration remains 1d3 rounds and the target that makes their save is still dazzled for 1 round. If you hit the same target, the duration of the effects do not stack, instead the condition is replaced by the condition with the longer duration or greater effect if both are 1 round.
